mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.content, r.score, r.is_anonymous as isAnonymous, rt.type_name as roomTypeName, r.order_id as orderId, r.create_time as createTime, r.reply, r.reply_time as replyTime FROM review r LEFT JOIN room_type rt ON r.room_type_id = rt.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.id, r.content, r.score, r.create_time as createTime, r.reply, r.reply_time as replyTime, r.is_anonymous as isAnonymous, r.user_id as userId FROM review r WHERE r.room_type_id = #{roomTypeId} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE review SET reply = #{reply}, reply_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
